sourceScope.sourceStory: Already mid-action, Pip the rabbit tries to place one sticky note on the toy cabinet's empty front panel, but it clings to Pip's fingertip while the cabinet stays untouched. Pip tries to peel the note away with the free hand, but it splits into two notes, one on each hand. Pip tries to press both notes onto the cabinet, but they spring back and double into four notes. Pip tries to push the four notes off against the cabinet door edge, but they split into eight and cover Pip's arms and face. Pip sees the four-to-eight change finish, realizes that every removal or transfer attempt multiplies the notes, deliberately stops struggling, and turns the still note-covered face toward the mirror. Pip remains covered until a sneeze scatters the notes onto the cabinet. Pip is relieved, but the cabinet remains messy.

alternatives.text: Pip the rabbit stands before the toy cabinet's bare front panel, one sticky note pinched between two fingers, already reaching to press it flat. The note clings to Pip's fingertip while the cabinet stays untouched. Pip peels it with the free hand and it splits into two notes, one stuck to each hand. Pip presses both palms to the cabinet; they spring back and double into four notes, now dotting Pip's wrists. Pip backs away, arms out, and the four notes split into eight across Pip's arms and face. Pip freezes, eyes wide above a note stuck to the muzzle, and watches the last split finish. Pip deliberately lowers both arms and stops struggling. The still note-covered face turns toward the mirror. Pip holds still, breathing, until a sneeze bursts out and scatters the notes onto the cabinet. Pip is relieved, but the cabinet remains messy.

alternatives.text: Pip the rabbit reaches to smooth one sticky note onto the toy cabinet's bare front panel, but it clings to Pip's fingertip while the cabinet stays untouched. Pip pinches the note with the other paw to peel it free, and it splits into two notes, one stuck to each paw. Pip slaps both paws toward the cabinet, but the notes bounce back and double into four, fluttering up Pip's arms. Pip shakes both arms hard to fling the four notes away, and they split into eight, plastering Pip's chest and cheeks. Pip freezes, watching the eight notes ripple and settle, and realizes that every removal or transfer attempt multiplies the notes. Pip deliberately stops struggling and stands still, letting the notes rest. A sneeze bursts out of Pip, and the blast peels the notes off and scatters them across the cabinet. Pip is relieved, but the cabinet remains messy.

scope.sourceStory: Already mid-action, Pip the rabbit tries to place one sticky note on the toy cabinet's empty front panel, but it clings to Pip's fingertip while the cabinet stays untouched. Pip tries to peel the note away with the free hand, but it splits into two notes, one on each hand. Pip tries to press both notes onto the cabinet, but they spring back and double into four notes. Pip tries to push the four notes off against the cabinet door edge, but they split into eight and cover Pip's arms and face. Pip sees the four-to-eight change finish, realizes that every removal or transfer attempt multiplies the notes, deliberately stops struggling, and turns the still note-covered face toward the mirror. Pip remains covered until a sneeze scatters the notes onto the cabinet. Pip is relieved, but the cabinet remains messy.
